name: Solenne Mirrorweave Bioluminescent Gala Gown
description:
Solenne's flagship gala gown is among the most recognized formal garments produced in Meridian 88, which is partly by design — it is meant to be seen and remembered. The foundation fabric is a proprietary mirrorweave silk-analog that shifts between deep iridescence and near-opacity depending on viewing angle and ambient light, creating the impression that the gown is made of something between water and metal. The hem is seeded with bioluminescent thread — a TESSERA-licensed biological compound woven directly into the fabric — that activates in low light and pulses with a slow, steady rhythm calibrated to approximate a resting heartbeat. The effect in a darkened gala space is genuinely arresting.

The gown is fully custom-fitted via biometric scan and accommodates virtually any geneware modification — tail vents, wing slits, horn clearance at the neckline, and fur-friendly interior lining are all available as standard specifications. BCI-responsive color modulation allows the iridescent base to shift through a curated palette at the wearer's thought. A single gown of this type costs more than a Tier 2 resident earns in a year. This is not incidental to its design.
cultural_context: The Solenne mirrorweave gown is a Spire status object. Being seen in one at a gala communicates wealth, access, and a certain kind of confidence. The bioluminescent hem is distinctive enough that observers remember it specifically. Some wearers find that uncomfortable. Most do not.
story_hooks: A character wearing this gown to a public-facing Spire event is photographed extensively. The images circulate on Ringo media feeds. Someone on the Shelf recognizes the person wearing it as someone who grew up three doors down from them.
The BCI color modulation begins responding to emotional states the wearer did not intend to display. The gown is, in a roomful of observers, reading the wearer more accurately than they'd like.
A Solenne gown appears at a Tier 2 secondhand market — damaged, the bioluminescent hem dark. Someone spent Φ5800 on this and it ended up here. The question of how is the beginning of something.
